conclusions.rationale: Independence of D and the evaluation sample preserves the conditional iid law. Conditional boundedness and measurability permit Hoeffding, with conditional mean equal to the uniform integral; integration preserves the same bound.
conclusions.repair: No repair is needed. The fitted function may be random because it is independent of the evaluation observations.
